subtitle: A sand spit between the Atlantic and the Lagoa do Roteiro in Alagoas, whose 64-stall beach complex was still working through state environmental permitting years after it was built.
spike_statement: By 2017, Gunga's 14 bar-restaurants, 18 food stalls and 32 craft stalls ran roughly 600 jobs, still pending the state's environmental sign-off.

levers.photo_tone: Coconut-lined sand spit between flat lagoon green and open Atlantic blue, kiosk smoke and boat wakes breaking the postcard symmetry
